runners.boundary: Historical runner bytes are unavailable when the current source differs from the batch declaration; the declared hash and current hash are retained without treating current bytes as the original runner.

runnerHashExceptions.reason: The historical 60-second batch declared an older runner. The current 180-second runner is retained separately and is not relabeled as the historical bytes.

performance.interpretation: Every configured performance batch is retained, including failed and partial runs. Mechanical evidence verification is independent of the performance target; the formal matrix is incomplete and the performance gate remains failed.

runners.boundary: Historical runner bytes cannot be reconstructed from the current tool. Its actual manifest declaration and original failure/output bytes remain preserved; no current revision is mislabeled as the original.
